subject: Kickoff: Medilabs pilot MAP and evaluation roadmap
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Ayesha Rahman <ayesha.rahman@medilabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: Medilabs pilot MAP and evaluation roadmap

Hi Ayesha —

Thanks again for carving out time this week. As discussed, I wanted to kick off a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to align on goals, owners, and a pragmatic timeline for the pilot. I attached a first-pass MAP workbook (medilabs_map_draft_v1.xlsx) — lightweight, editable, and organized by week.

High-level goals I have captured:
- Pilot objective: validate LLM-assisted triage in Medilabs Support workflow (reduce avg triage time by 30%)
- Success criteria: end-to-end latency < 250ms for 95th pct, qualitative accuracy >= 85% on the evaluation set, integration completed on staging by end of pilot
- Timeline target: 8-week pilot, kickoff next week, pilot report + recommendation by May 5

Proposed owners:
- Medilabs champion: Ayesha (primary)
- Technical contact: Tom (integration + infra)
- Redwood AE: me (Nikhil) — MAP owner and timeline coordinator
- Redwood SE: Marissa — demo, technical onboarding, eval harness

As next steps:
1) Can you confirm the goals above and the proposed timeline?
2) If acceptable, please confirm a 30-45 minute kickoff next Tue (Mar 15) so Marissa can walk through the evaluation plan and we can assign tasks.
3) I included the product overview for your procurement team. If you have any immediate procurement asks (SOC2, data residency, indemnity), flag them here and I’ll loop in our security/finance leads.

Attachments: medilabs_map_draft_v1.xlsx, redwood-product-overview.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on this.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
nikhil.sharma@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198
From: Ayesha Rahman <ayesha.rahman@medilabs.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@medilabs.com>, Sara Liu <sara.liu@medilabs.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Medilabs pilot MAP and evaluation roadmap

Hi Nikhil —

Thanks for the clear write-up and the MAP draft. The goals look aligned with what we discussed. A few quick notes from my side:
- Pilot objective and success criteria: agreed, though we’d like to add a secondary metric around false-positive rate on triage suggestions (target < 10%).
- Timeline: 8 weeks works but can we shift the kickoff to Mar 16? Our engineering lead (Tom) is out on Mar 15.
- Procurement: I’ve attached our procurement checklist and SOC2 request — procurement will need SOC2 Type II and a data processing addendum; Sara is leading that.

We’re happy to proceed. Confirming: I’ll be the champion and Tom will own the integration. Please include your security contact for the SOC2 questions.

Ayesha Rahman
Director of Support Automation, Medilabs Health
ayesha.rahman@medilabs.com
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Ayesha Rahman <ayesha.rahman@medilabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 11:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Medilabs pilot MAP and evaluation roadmap

Ayesha —

Appreciate the quick reply and the procurement checklist. We can add the false-positive target to the success criteria — noted. Mar 16 works for us; I’ll send a calendar invite for 30 minutes and include a short agenda (intro, evaluation rubric, integration touchpoints, immediate blockers).

On SOC2: Ethan (cc’d) is our security & compliance lead and will follow up with the SOC2 report and DPA routing. Marissa — can you bring the evaluation harness plan and a suggested sample size for Medilabs’ triage logs (we typically recommend ~2k labeled interactions for a reliable signal)?

Next steps:
- I’ll publish v1.1 of the MAP with the false-positive metric and updated kickoff date (attached).
- Send calendar invite for Mar 16, 09:30–10:00 PT.
- Ethan to share SOC2 and DPA docs by EOD.

Attachments: medilabs_map_draft_v1.xlsx (will be updated to v1.1 post-kickoff)

Best,
Nikhil
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Quick internal note —

Agenda items I’ll cover on Mar 16:
- Evaluation rubric (accuracy, false-positive rate, latency sampling)
- Data requirements and safe redaction checklist for triage logs
- Test harness: how we’ll run offline evals + integration smoke tests

Prep items for us:
- Nikhil: confirm calendar slot and final MAP v1.1 before EOD Fri (Mar 12)
- Grace: bring contact plan for CS during pilot and outline onboarding tasks for Medilabs’ support team
- Ethan: be ready to post SOC2 assets into the procurement thread — procurement asked specifically for encryption and retention detail

I’ll draft the evaluation sample spec (2k interactions, stratified by category) and link to the notebook in the Drive before the call.

-Marissa
